issue.body:
## Problem

The live v2 publication skill explicitly permits bounded reconciliation of an existing governed draft PR to ready state, but the current authoritative `csdlc-publish` command exposes only `publish`, `status`, and `schema`. The previously implemented typed `ready` and `reconcile-ready` commands are absent.

## Reproduction

At current main and the installed v2 generation:

```text
.adl/bin/csdlc-v2/csdlc-publish --help
Commands: publish, status, schema
```

Historical commit `167e8b9b4` contains the typed ready and reconciliation implementation and tests. Current `csdlc-v2/operator/skills/csdlc-v2-publish/SKILL.md` still refers to bounded ready reconciliation commands.

## Impact

A correctly governed draft publication such as PR #598 cannot advance to ready state through the sole authoritative typed v2 command surface. Raw GitHub mutation is prohibited except through audited break-glass, so otherwise complete exact-head work becomes stranded.

## Acceptance criteria

- Restore a typed, exact-identity draft-to-ready operation under the authoritative v2 publication owner.
- Re-observe the exact repository, PR, head SHA, open state, and draft state before and after mutation.
- Record ready publication truth atomically and provide reconciliation after an uncertain remote response.
- Reject mismatched repository, PR, head, non-draft pre-state, closed state, stale generation, or stale digest without lifecycle mutation.
- Align the publication skill text and installed binary inventory with the implemented command surface.
- Add focused tests for success, remote uncertainty, recovery, identity drift, and zero-write failure paths.

## Scope boundary

This is lifecycle tooling only. It does not change Runtime v3 behavior or absorb Issue #589 implementation scope.

issue.title: [C-SDLC v2] Restore governed draft-to-ready publication reconciliation
